title: Trigger
text: Add trigger or function port to subsystem or model, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets time interval; {Trigger type} selects the type of control, {Treat as Simulink function} sets the create Simulink Function block, {Execute function call asynchronously} sets the whether caller request to call function can wait for service, {Function name} sets the function name for Simulink Function block, {Function visibility} selects scope visibility, {Scope to port} sets the name of exporting function port, {Enable variant condition} Controls activating the variant control, {Variant control}, {Generate preprocessor conditionals} controls enclosing variant choices, {States when enabling} selects how to set block state, {Propagate sizes of variable-size signals} selects when to propagate variable-size signals During, {Show output port} controls display of output port, {Output data type} selects output port data type, {Sample time type} selects calling rate, {Enable zero-crossing detection} controls zero-crossing detection, {Initial trigger signal state} selects the initial state of the trigger signal, {Trigger time} sets when message input triggers execution of subsystem on message, {Schedule as aperiodic partition} sets the immediate mode or scheduled mode, {Port dimensions} sets the dimensions for the trigger signal, {Trigger signal sample time} sets the time interval, {Minimum} sets the minimum output value for the trigger signal, {Maximum} sets the maximum output value for the trigger signal, {Data type} selects output data type for the trigger signal, {Mode} selects data type category and {Interpolate data} controls how missing workspace data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Value that describes control signal or message payload scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Select the type of control signal rising (default) | falling | either | function-call | message

params.name: Treat as Simulink function
params.values: Create Simulink Function block off (default) | on

params.name: Execute function call asynchronously
params.values: Whether caller request to call function can wait for service execution off (default) | on

params.name: Function name
params.values: Specify function name for Simulink Function block f (default) | function name

params.name: Function visibility
params.values: Select scope visibility of function scoped (default) | global | port

params.name: Scope to port
params.values: Specify name of exporting function port ’’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Enable variant condition
params.values: Controls activating the variant control (condition) off (default) | on

params.name: Variant control
params.values: Specify variant control (condition) expression (inherit) (default) | logical expression

params.name: Generate preprocessor conditionals
params.values: Control enclosing variant choices off (default) | on

params.name: States when enabling
params.values: Select how to set block state values held (default) | reset | inherit

params.name: Propagate sizes of variable-size signals
params.values: Select when to propagate variable-size signals During execution (default) | Only when enabling

params.name: Show output port
params.values: Control display of output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Select output port data type auto (default) | double | int8

params.name: Sample time type
params.values: Select calling rate triggered (default) | periodic

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Specify time interval 1 (default) | Ts | [Ts, To] | -1

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: Control zero-crossing detection on (default) | off

params.name: Initial trigger signal state
params.values: Select the initial state of the trigger signal compatibility (no trigger on first evaluation) (default) | zero | positive | negative

params.name: Trigger time
params.values: Specify when message input triggers execution of subsystem on message available (default) | on sample time hit

params.name: Schedule as aperiodic partition
params.values: Specify immediate mode or scheduled mode for execution on (default) | off

params.name: Port dimensions
params.values: Specify dimensions for the trigger signal 1 (default) | [n] | [m n] | -1

params.name: Trigger signal sample time
params.values: Specify time interval -1 (default) | Ts | [Ts, To]

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Specify minimum output value for the trigger signal [] (default) | real scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Specify maximum output value for the trigger signal [] (default) | real scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Select output data type for the trigger signal Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^,0) |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Select data type category Built in (default) | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Interpolate data
params.values: Control how missing workspace data is estimated on (default) | off
